info.name: Alfred - Travel API
info.description: Travel module: trips (with legs, stays, tags), places and the travel tag vocabulary. Run in order. Everything created is synthetic and deleted at the end.

item.name: 04 - List Trips Filtered By Unknown Tag

exec: pm.test('Local time shown in the zone', () => pm.expect(j.arrives_local).to.eql('2031-12-17T10:00:00'));
pm.test('Has the leg and stay', () => { pm.expect(j.legs.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.stays.length).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 18 - Update Trip Dates Out Of Order
23 - List Places By Tag And Grade

exec: pm.test('Not listed before it has a grade', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]));
pm.test('Place and trip embedded', () => { pm.expect(j.place.name).to.eql('Hotel Postman'); pm.expect(j.trip_name).to.include('Postman trip'); });

item.name: 30 - List Places By Tag And Grade After Grading

exec: pm.test('Listed with derived grade', () => { pm.expect(found.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(found[0].grade).to.eql(5); pm.expect(found[0].grade_count).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 31 - Place Not In Any Trip Filter

exec: pm.test('A place with a trip visit is excluded', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_place_id'))));
pm.test('History has the visit and the stay', () => { pm.expect(j.visits.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.stays.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Itinerary has the visit', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.visits.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.hidden_visit_count).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('Has the ideas list and warnings array', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.ideas).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.warnings).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Not stamped outside the trip dates', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().tags).to.eql([]));
pm.test('Shared charge counted once in the total', () => { pm.expect(j.total.total_eur).to.eql('25.50'); pm.expect(j.total.transaction_count).to.eql(2); });
pm.test('Grouped by kind', () => { const kinds = j.by_kind.map(k => k.kind); pm.expect(kinds).to.include.members(['flight', 'lodging']); });

item.name: 46a - Get Trip Charges Behind The Cost

exec: pm.test('Same charges as the cost total', () => { pm.expect(j.transactions.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.cost.total_eur).to.eql('25.50'); });

item.name: 46b - Get Trip Charges Of One Kind

exec: pm.test('The stay still needs a grade and notes', () => { const stay = j.to_complete.find(i => i.kind === 'stay'); pm.expect(stay.missing).to.eql(['grade', 'notes']); });
pm.test('The graded visit is complete and a highlight', () => { pm.expect(j.to_complete.find(i => i.kind === 'visit')).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(j.highlights[0].grade).to.eql(5); });

pm.test('Pins listed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.points).to.be.an('array'); j.points.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.address).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: 49 - Get Trip Recap Map Pins Missed Only

exec: pm.test('Pins listed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.points).to.be.an('array'); j.points.forEach(p => { pm.expect(p.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.address).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: 50 - Get Trip Recap Map Pins Bad Scope

exec: pm.test('Shape', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.trip_id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_trip_id'))); pm.expect(j.visits).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('to_mark'); });

item.name: 54 - Get Other Events Of Unknown Trip

exec: pm.test('Degrades instead of failing', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['forecast','climate','none']).to.include(j.mode); pm.expect(j.cities).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.finished).to.be.a('boolean'); });
pm.test('Three lists', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); ['birthdays','tasks','charges'].forEach(k => pm.expect(j[k]).to.be.an('array')); });

item.name: 58 - Get While Away Of Unknown Trip

exec: pm.test('Linked and out-of-range charges are not listed', () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(t => t.id); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_txn_id'))); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_outside_id'))); });

item.name: 60 - Get Unlinked Transactions Of Unknown Trip

exec: pm.test('Charges and the unlinked cost are returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.transactions).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.cost).to.have.property('total_eur'); });

item.name: 60b - Get Tagged Transactions Of Unknown Trip

exec: pm.test('Lists are returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.moved).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.failed).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: 63 - Visit Event Action With Bad Action
64 - Visit Event Action With Update Visit

exec: pm.test('Done, or refused with a reason (depends on whether Google is connected)', () => { pm.expect([200, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); if (pm.response.code === 422) pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.be.a('string'); });

68 - List Trips By City And Country

exec: pm.test('Found through its stay and visit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(t => t.id)).to.include(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_trip_id'))));

pm.test('Carries its cities and countries', () => { const t = pm.response.json().find(t => t.id === Number(pm.environment.get('travel_trip_id'))); pm.expect(t.cities).to.include('Testville'); pm.expect(t.countries).to.include('Testland'); });

item.name: 69b - Trip Locations For The Filters Autocomplete

exec: pm.test('Lists the trip places city and country', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.cities).to.include('Testville'); pm.expect(j.countries).to.include('Testland'); });
pm.test('A graded place is not listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_place_id'))));

item.name: 70b - Place Locations For The Filters Autocomplete

exec: pm.test('Lists the place city and country', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.cities).to.include('Testville'); pm.expect(j.countries).to.include('Testland'); });

item.name: 72 - Apply Default Tags To Existing Expenses

exec: pm.test('Already stamped expenses are not tagged twice', () => pm.expect(j.added).to.eql(0));

exec: pm.test('Visit limit and unpaid-leg window have defaults', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().max_visits_per_day).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().unpaid_leg_days).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Only the sent field changed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.airport_buffer_min).to.eql(95); pm.expect(j.home_to_airport_min).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_ride_original'))); });

item.name: 94a - Moved Constants Default To The Old Values

exec: pm.test('Seeded defaults are anchored and signed', () => { pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(items.every(i => ['start','end'].includes(i.anchor))).to.eql(true); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('checklist_original', JSON.stringify(items.map(i => ({ anchor: i.anchor, name: i.name, offset_days: i.offset_days }))));

item.name: 96 - Put Checklist Template With A New Item

exec: pm.variables.set('checklist_body', JSON.stringify({ items: [...original, { anchor: 'end', name: 'postman-check', offset_days: -2 }] }));

pm.test('The new item is listed with a humanized title', () => { const item = pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.name === 'postman-check'); pm.expect(item.title).to.eql('postman check'); pm.expect(item.offset_days).to.eql(-2); });

item.name: 97 - Put Checklist Template With A Name Under Both Anchors
98 - Put Checklist Template With Bad Anchor
99 - Put Checklist Template With Bad Name

exec: pm.test('The added item is deleted', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.name)).to.not.include('postman-check'));
pm.test('The template is back to what it was', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(i => ({ anchor: i.anchor, name: i.name, offset_days: i.offset_days }))).to.eql(original));
pm.test('Kind is guessed from the domain', () => pm.expect(j.kind).to.eql('website'));
pm.test('The typed title wins', () => pm.expect(j.title).to.eql('Postman tips'));
pm.test('Instagram kind, no fetched preview', () => { pm.expect(j.kind).to.eql('instagram'); pm.expect(j.image_url).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('Updated', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.kind).to.eql('article'); pm.expect(j.notes).to.eql('Read before the trip'); });

item.name: 142 - Create Place With A New City By Name

exec: pm.test('City created in the existing country', () => { pm.expect(j.city.name).to.eql('Postman Newtown ' + pm.environment.get('travel_ts')); pm.expect(j.city.country.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_country_id'))); });

item.name: 144 - Create Place With Only A City Name
145 - Create Place With An Unknown City Id
146 - Move A Place To Another City
147 - Rename A Place City Keeping The Country

exec: pm.test('Same country, new city', () => { pm.expect(j.city.name).to.eql('Postman Renamed ' + pm.environment.get('travel_ts')); pm.expect(j.city.country.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_country_id'))); });

pm.test('The base city only: no travel figures', () => { pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_city_id'))); pm.expect(j.country.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_country_id'))); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('default_tag_names'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('place_count'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('trips'); });

pm.test('The base country only: no travel figures', () => { pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_country_id'))); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('code'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('created_at'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('cities'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('costs'); });

pm.test('Owned by the city', () => { pm.expect(j.city_id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_city_id'))); pm.expect(j.trip_id).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.place_id).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.country_id).to.eql(null); });

exec: pm.test('Home city is returned with its country', () => { pm.expect(j.home_city_id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('travel_home_city_id'))); pm.expect(j.home_city.country.name).to.eql('Testland'); });
pm.test('Flagged as home, with spend', () => { pm.expect(j.home).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.costs.overall.transaction_count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.default_tag_names).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('Says it is the home city', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include('home city'));
pm.test('Stored on the trip', () => { pm.expect(j.home_address).to.eql('Rua Postman 1'); pm.expect(j.airport_buffer_min).to.eql(45); pm.expect(j.home_to_airport_min).to.eql(15); });

item.name: 185 - Trip Detail Shows Its Own Home

exec: pm.test('From the trip', () => { pm.expect(j.home.from_trip).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.home.address).to.eql('Rua Postman 1'); pm.expect(j.home.airport_buffer_min).to.eql(45); });

item.name: 186 - Set Trip Home To An Unknown City

exec: pm.test('Follows the settings again', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.home_city_id).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.airport_buffer_min).to.eql(null); });

item.name: 188 - Trip Airport Minutes Out Of Range

exec: pm.test('No home city', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.home_city_id).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.home_city).to.eql(null); });
